name: frontend-skills
description: React/TypeScript + Go enforcement harness. Hooks enforce accessibility, React/TypeScript correctness, styling, env/data rules, warning-free tests and CI, PR feedback completeness, worktree safety, and lockfile parity. Skills cover planning, TDD, review, dependency upgrades, resilience, PR reviewability, visual planning, status summaries, CI-green shipping, and handoff. Includes Builder.io and Cursor Team Kit workflows. POSIX-friendly.

x-changelog.4.9.0: 2026-04-23 -- Green != done warnings gate. Two new hooks (89 -> 91 wired, 98 -> 100 scripts). (1) `test-warning-check.sh` (PostToolUse Bash): hard-blocks on exit=0 from `vitest` / `bun test` / `playwright` / `tsgo` / `tsc` / `biome` / `lint`, scans stdout + stderr for curated warning patterns -- Node `DeprecationWarning`, `ExperimentalWarning`, `(node:...) XxxWarning`, React `Warning: An update to .* inside a test was not wrapped in act`, `Warning: Each child in a list should have a unique "key"`, `Warning: validateDOMNesting`, `Warning: Failed prop type`, `Warning: Cannot update a component .* while rendering`, `Warning: Received .* for a non-boolean attribute`, `MaxListenersExceededWarning` / `PossibleEventEmitterMemoryLeak`, `UnhandledPromiseRejection` / `Unhandled Rejection` / `Unhandled Errors`, vitest `stderr |` during test, `Tests skipped N`, `@ts-expect-error`, `@ts-ignore`, `npm WARN deprecated`. Blocks with systemMessage and file:line sample. No per-file or env bypass. 3x same-kind streak escalates via warning-streak tracker. (2) `ci-warning-audit.sh` (Stop hook): gated on feature branch + session touched code + PR exists + all CI checks SUCCESS (pending/failing defers to lifecycle-stop). Resolves PR head SHA, fetches `gh run view <id> --log` with 45s timeout, pipes through grep on the same curated pattern, heads 30. Per-SHA cache in session dir so repeat Stops don't re-fetch the same log. `hook_stop_block` with file:line sample + suggested full-log command. No CI warning env bypass. (3) CLAUDE.md Tests section + tdd/SKILL.md `When Done` checklist updated: zero warnings in local output AND CI, with no-bypass warning enforcement documented. Why: passing tests can silently spew deprecations, log errors, leak unhandled rejections -- noise that rots into real bugs when the lib actually removes the API. 'Green' was never the bar; zero warnings is.
x-changelog.4.8.0: 2026-04-22 -- /steelman anti-sycophancy skill (opt-in only). New skill at steelman/SKILL.md argues strongest opposite case with repo evidence on user assertions -- factual/causal/architectural claim types only (preference/goal/scope declined). Procedure: identify claim -> fan-out evidence gather (grep, read, run) -> write counter-argument with file:line refs -> verdict (confirmed | contradicted | mixed). User-invoked via `/steelman` slash only. **No ambient CLAUDE.md rule, no automatic hook fire, no telemetry log script** -- plugin consumers see zero behavior change unless they type `/steelman`. Ambient premise-check directive + jsonl telemetry were considered and held back pending real-world feedback on the opt-in surface; re-evaluate once /steelman fire-rate data exists from dogfooding. Why: LLM sycophancy risk when the user asserts something wrong and the model agrees by default -- /steelman forces the strongest counter-case with repo evidence before proceeding. Skills 47 -> 48 (registers the skill file that was previously on disk but unlisted).
